additives.name: Ammonium Hydrogen Carbonate
additives.description: Leavening agent used in baked goods. Emits ammonia during high-temperature baking.
health_warnings: May produce mild irritation in respiratory tract if inhaled in raw powder form, generally safe once baked.

additives.name: Sodium Hydrogen Carbonate
additives.description: Common baking soda used as an aerating agent.
health_warnings: High sodium contribution for hypertensive patients.

additives.name: Monosodium Glutamate
additives.description: Umami flavor enhancer commonly used in savory snacks, instant noodles, and soups.
health_warnings: Can cause headache, flushing, and sweating in sensitive individuals ('Chinese Restaurant Syndrome'). Not recommended for infants.

additives.name: Carrageenan
additives.description: Polysaccharide extracted from red edible seaweeds, used in chocolate milk, vegan dairy, and ice cream.
health_warnings: Strong clinical evidence of intestinal mucosal inflammation, ulceration, and IBS exacerbation.

additives.name: Sucralose
additives.description: Chlorinated zero-calorie artificial sweetener 600x sweeter than sucrose.
health_warnings: Alters gut microbiome diversity; thermal degradation during baking produces toxic chloropropanols; WHO warns against long-term use for weight control.

additives.name: Aspartame
additives.description: Methyl ester of phenylalanine/aspartic acid. 200x sweeter than sugar.
health_warnings: Classified by WHO/IARC as Group 2B (Possibly carcinogenic to humans). Decomposes into formaldehyde and phenylalanine under heat.

additives.name: Acesulfame Potassium
additives.description: Calorie-free sugar substitute often blended with sucralose or aspartame to mask bitter aftertastes.
health_warnings: Contains methylene chloride derivatives from production; associated with metabolic disruption.

additives.name: Sulphite Ammonia Caramel
additives.description: Dark brown coloring agent manufactured by heating carbohydrates with ammonia and sulphite compounds (used in colas and gravies).
health_warnings: Contains 4-methylimidazole (4-MEI), a potential animal carcinogen.

additives.name: Tartrazine
additives.description: Synthetic lemon-yellow azo dye used in extruded snacks, confectionery, and soft drinks.
health_warnings: Linked to hyperactivity and attention deficit in children (Southampton study warning required in EU). Strong trigger for hives and asthma.

additives.name: Sodium Benzoate
additives.description: Antimicrobial preservative used in acidic juices, carbonated beverages, and pickles.
health_warnings: Forms carcinogenic benzene when combined with Vitamin C (Ascorbic acid). May exacerbate hyperactivity in children.

additives.name: Lecithins
additives.description: Naturally derived fatty substance from soy or sunflower used to blend oil and water phases.
health_warnings: Generally recognized as safe. Potential allergen if derived from unrefined soy.

aliases: Mono- and Diglycerides of Fatty Acids
additives.name: Mono- and Di-glycerides of Fatty Acids
additives.description: Synthetic fat emulsifier extending shelf life in breads, cakes, and margarines. Often contains hidden trans fats.
health_warnings: Can introduce small quantities of unesterified trans-fatty acids not required to be declared on zero-trans-fat labels.

additives.name: Disodium 5-ribonucleotides
additives.description: Synergistic umami enhancer combining inosinate and guanylate. 4x more potent than MSG alone; widely used in instant noodles, crisps, and tastemaker seasoning packets.
health_warnings: Metabolizes into purines which rapidly elevate serum uric acid; can trigger acute gout flares. Suspected trigger for ribonucleotide contact dermatitis and asthmatic bronchospasms. Not permitted in infant foods.

additives.name: Potassium Chloride
additives.description: Naturally occurring mineral salt used to firm noodle texture, maintain gluten elasticity, and serve as a sodium-reducing mineral agent.
health_warnings: Generally recognized as safe; however, high potassium load is strictly contraindicated for patients with chronic kidney disease (CKD) who cannot excrete potassium.

additives.name: Guar Gum
additives.description: Water-soluble natural fiber extracted from guar beans. Imparts viscous body and springiness to instant noodles and sauces.
health_warnings: Generally safe prebiotic fiber. High dietary doses can cause abdominal gas, bloating, and gastrointestinal cramping in FODMAP-sensitive individuals.

additives.name: Potassium Carbonate
additives.description: Traditional alkaline Kansui salt essential for giving instant ramen and noodles their characteristic chewy texture, springiness, and golden hue.
health_warnings: Generally recognized as safe in customary food usage.

additives.name: Sodium Tripolyphosphate
additives.description: Inorganic polyphosphate salt used to retain moisture, prevent weeping, and accelerate rehydration of noodle strands in boiling water.
health_warnings: Frequent consumption of industrial phosphate additives is clinically linked to elevated serum phosphate, vascular endothelial calcification, and increased cardiovascular and renal disease burden.

additives.name: Pentasodium Triphosphate
additives.description: Phosphate salt used as a water-binding and emulsifying agent in processed meat and extruded starch products.
health_warnings: Elevates dietary phosphate burden, placing strain on renal clearance pathways.

additives.name: Citric Acid
additives.description: Naturally occurring fruit acid used industrially for tangy taste, antioxidant synergism, and microbial shelf-life preservation.
health_warnings: Generally recognized as safe; high frequent exposure to acidic beverages and snacks can accelerate tooth enamel demineralization.

additives.name: Disodium 5-guanylate
additives.description: Nucleotide flavor enhancer used alongside glutamate to create intense savory umami depth.
health_warnings: Metabolizes to uric acid; contraindicated for individuals prone to gout.

additives.name: Disodium 5-inosinate
additives.description: Nucleotide flavor enhancer frequently compounded with MSG to enhance palatability.
health_warnings: Purine content contributes to elevated serum uric acid levels.

additives.name: Tertiary Butylhydroquinone
additives.description: Petroleum-derived synthetic preservative sprayed into vegetable frying oils to prevent oxidation and rancidity in instant noodles and fried crisps.
health_warnings: High-dose toxicology studies in animal models reveal cellular liver damage, vision alterations, and immunological impairment. Strictly restricted under food laws.

additives.name: Butylated Hydroxyanisole
additives.description: Synthetic antioxidant preservative used to prevent fat spoilage in savory packaged goods.
health_warnings: Classified by WHO/IARC as possibly carcinogenic to humans; documented endocrine disrupting activity.

additives.name: Butylated Hydroxytoluene
additives.description: Synthetic fat-soluble antioxidant used in packaging liners and fried snack foods.
health_warnings: Linked to hepatic and renal strain in animal bioassays.

additives.name: Sunset Yellow FCF
additives.description: Synthetic petroleum azo dye producing bright sunset-orange color in snacks, beverage powders, and candies.
health_warnings: Southampton University research established strong links to attention deficit and hyperactivity in children. Frequent allergen for asthmatics.

additives.name: Carmoisine
additives.description: Synthetic red coal-tar azo dye.
health_warnings: Banned in the USA and Canada. Associated with hyperreactivity in young children and cutaneous urticaria.

additives.name: Titanium Dioxide
additives.description: Inorganic white mineral pigment.
health_warnings: BANNED in the European Union (EFSA 2021) as a food additive due to genotoxicity concerns and nanoparticle accumulation damaging cellular DNA.

additives.name: Xanthan Gum
additives.description: Bacterial fermentation polysaccharide providing stable viscosity across wide temperature and pH ranges.
health_warnings: Generally recognized as safe; mild laxative effect if consumed in excess.

additives.name: Sodium Carboxymethyl Cellulose
additives.description: Modified cellulose ether used to thicken sauces, gravies, and bakery products.
health_warnings: Peer-reviewed studies indicate CMC degrades intestinal mucus barriers, facilitating bacterial translocation and gut dysbiosis.

additives.name: Diacetyl Tartaric Acid Esters of Mono- and Diglycerides
additives.description: Synthetic emulsifier used to build dough strength, gas retention, and volume in bread and extruded noodles.
health_warnings: Processed fat compound containing minor unesterified trans fat fractions.

additives.name: Polyglycerol Polyricinoleate
additives.description: Synthetic castor-oil derived emulsifier used in chocolates to improve flow and replace cocoa butter.
health_warnings: Synthetic fat substitute permitted under strict dosage limits.

additives.name: Potassium Sorbate
additives.description: Potassium salt of natural sorbic acid preventing yeast and mold spoilage.
health_warnings: Generally recognized as safe.

additives.name: Sodium Metabisulphite
additives.description: Sulphite-releasing agent preventing enzymatic discoloration in potato and dough preparations.
health_warnings: Triggers severe, potentially life-threatening bronchospasms in sensitive asthmatics.

additives.name: Calcium Propionate
additives.description: Organic calcium salt inhibiting fungal growth in commercial bakery lines.
health_warnings: Clinical trials reported behavioral changes, restlessness, and sleep disturbances in children.

additives.name: Silicon Dioxide
additives.description: Inert synthetic amorphous silica added to seasoning powders and spice mixes to prevent caking.
health_warnings: Generally recognized as safe at prescribed limits.

disguised_sugars.name: Maltodextrin
disguised_sugars.description: Hydrolyzed starch polymer rapidly digested into glucose with a higher glycemic index than pure sugar (GI 110-185 vs Sugar 65).
disguised_sugars.deceptive_practice: Used in 'No Added Sugar' and 'Health Drink' powders as a bulking agent to evade sugar declaration thresholds.

disguised_sugars.name: Invert Sugar Syrup
disguised_sugars.description: Equimolar mixture of glucose and fructose produced by splitting sucrose.
disguised_sugars.deceptive_practice: Prevents crystallization and retains moisture in baked goods while masking true total sugar volume.

disguised_sugars.name: High Fructose Corn Syrup
disguised_sugars.description: Industrial liquid sweetener high in unbound fructose.
disguised_sugars.deceptive_practice: Promotes visceral fat accumulation, hepatic de novo lipogenesis, and non-alcoholic fatty liver.

disguised_sugars.name: Liquid Glucose
disguised_sugars.description: Purified concentrated aqueous solution of nutritive saccharides obtained from starch.
disguised_sugars.deceptive_practice: Listed as an ingredient alongside table sugar to split sugar weighting in the ingredient hierarchy.

disguised_sugars.name: Palm Oil / Palm Olein
disguised_sugars.description: Cheap tropical oil containing 50% saturated palmitic acid.
disguised_sugars.deceptive_practice: Labelled deceptively as 'Edible Vegetable Oil' without disclosing it is 100% refined palm oil to cut manufacturing costs.
